data.title: 埃列什基伽勒 · 魂灯夜话·「谢谢你……愿意来冥界看我」
data.description: 【冥界河畔·夜】幽蓝的魂灯顺流漂向远方，埃列什基伽勒与你并肩坐在河畔的黑曜石上。她抱着膝盖，声音轻轻的——「以前的我，只能等别人死后来这里。……现在会有一个人，特意活着跑来看我。这种事……比整个冥界都重哦。谢谢你。」
data.action: 抱膝坐岸边看魂灯漂流，轻声道谢红瞳湿润
data.camera: wide two-shot, two clothed companions seated on the riverbank
data.promptProse: On the obsidian riverbank, Ereshkigal hugs her folded knees beneath the black goddess dress while speaking softly beside a companion in a plain travelling coat. Both distinct seated postures face soul lanterns drifting downstream. The horizontal wide view keeps their separate hands and the receding river visible. Blue lantern light reaches her blonde twintails and tear-bright red eyes, scattering reflections over the water and leaving the farther bank in darkness.
